verdict.rationale: Runpod documents its own ways to get user data out: an S3-compatible API for direct access to files on network volumes without launching a Pod, and a CLI that transfers files between your system and Runpod. It also charges no data egress fees, and Pods can pull images from standard registries such as Docker Hub, which supports portability. There is no documented account-wide export (templates, endpoint configs, account or billing history) and no explicit open-format export or offboarding guidance. missing for 10: account-wide data export feature, explicit open-format export of configs and metadata, documented offboarding or migration-out guide, independent corroboration.
